reference.title: AT+MHTTPHEADER Set HTTP Specific Header
reference.shortdesc: This command is used to set the specific header.

row.entry: If succeed: +MHTTPHEADER: (list of supported <httpid>s),(list of supported <eof>s),(list of supported <length>s), OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>

If succeed:
<httpid> is configured only to query the configured header: [+MHTTPHEADER: <httpid>,<length>,<header>] OK<eof> is configured while <length> and <header> are not. Send data by CTRL+Z, and cancel sending by ESC: >(input data) OK<length> is configured while <header> is not. Send data when input data reaches the specified length or timeout is reached: >(input data) OKAll parameters set: OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>

Valid for a single request and automatically cleared upon request completion. Specific header primarily contains fields that vary across different requests. If the same field exists in the common header, it will be automatically replaced with the value from the specific header when the request is sent. When the <header> parameter is omitted in the set command, the module enters data mode, indicated by the > prompt for data input. The <input_format> parameter configured in AT+MHTTPCFG="encoding" only applies to the input mode with <header> specified in direct commands, and is ineffective for data mode. In data mode, raw data is used directly.

plentry.pd: The header input termination marker. Subsequent input is only permitted after the request completes or is cleared.
Subsequent header data input is pending.

row.entry:
<length>Data input length 0-4096. In data mode, setting to 0 is not permitted. When directly inputting data in command mode: If set to 0, no length validation is performed on the input data; If set >0, the system will validate the input data length. (For ASCII and escaped string input modes: The system shall validate whether the actual input string length in the command matches the specified length. For HEX string input mode: The system shall verify the actual input string length equals twice the specified length.) MN327: In direct command input mode, the maximum length of a single command is 2048 characters; exceeding this limit will result in an error.
ML302S/ML307S/ML305M/ML307M/ML307H/ML307N/ML307X/ML307Y/ML307B/MR380M: In data mode, this can be set to 0.
ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML307R/ML307C/MR380R: Command mode length range: 0-1024; Data mode length range: 0-4096; in data mode, this can be set to 0.
ML305U: In data mode, setting to 0 is permitted. The parameter defaults to 0 when the parameter is omitted.

<header>Specific header data is valid for a single request and automatically cleared upon request completion. If the same field is configured via AT+MHTTPCFG="header", the module will automatically use the currently set value internally. ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML305U/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307G/ML307M/ML307H/ML307N/ML307X/ML307Y: String parameters must not contain quotation marks. To include quotation marks within the string parameter, use data mode for transmission.
Set specific header AT+MHTTPHEADER=0,0,0,"api-key: FC9B69m4prHH2j7ljBbA=hHlbMI=" OK

note.div: M5310-E/MN327/MN328/MN318/MN316/MN319/MN319-A/MN326/MN316A/MN326A: The > data input mode is not supported, data must be input directly in the AT command. Single input length is limited by platform's single command constraints, thus, for larger data, multiple inputs are recommended.
MN319/MN319-A: The maximum length of AT command parameter is 1,560 bytes.
ML307X/ML307Y: The total writable data length shall not exceed 8,192 bytes.
ML307B: The maximum length of AT command parameter is 3,000 bytes.
